{"body":"## Mandate

This issue is the final release gate for v0.8 and carries the authority to delay the release. It stays open until the audit is clean; v0.8 MUST NOT be tagged while it (or any issue it files) is open.

Once every other v0.8 milestone issue is closed (epic #1104 tree: #1149–#1159 and the epic closeout), run a complete INDEPENDENT contract audit of the corpus — fresh reviewers with no prior context from the batch PRs (highest-tier model for gate/merge machinery, strong panel for the docs corpus).

## Audit scope

1. **Rule ownership, corpus-wide**: `scripts/docs/validate-rule-ownership.mjs` green; every normative doc opens with a canonical-owner line; no rule restated outside its owner doc; required-rules manifest covers the corpus (epic AC1).
2. **L2/L3 conformance**: `scripts/docs/validate-state-machine-conformance.mjs` over ALL wired machines (pr-gate-coordination + the machines wired by #1156/#1157); no stale known-gap/allowlist entries (each must reference an open tracking issue); L3 completeness/safety/liveness pass (epic AC3).
3. **Contradiction scan**: RFC-2119 conflict review across the entire rule registry — MUST vs MUST NOT on the same behavior, conflicting guards/preconditions, modality downgrades; the deterministic modality-conflict scan gating state per #1159 (epic AC4).
4. **Phrase-pin zero-state**: no exact-sentence pins on normative prose remain in test/contracts (epic AC2).
5. **Semantic-drift spot-checks**: sample reworded rules from every batch against their pre-epic baselines (git history) — zero meaning change, conditions/guards/exceptions intact.
6. **Epic closeout**: #1104 AC1–AC6 and DoD1–DoD3 verified (word-count roll-up posted, validator/harness status in the closing comment).
7. **Dedup / condensation lens (dedicated)**: epic #1104 promised condensation, but the later batches trended net-positive (+341/+227/+109/+55) and every rule marker adds LoC even when words drop. The audit MUST produce hard numbers: (a) corpus-wide `wc -w` AND `wc -l` over all contract docs (skills/docs, docs/, skills/*/SKILL.md, agents/, commands/) at the pre-epic baseline commit vs the audited head, total and per doc; (b) growth attribution — machine annotation (marker/ID lines) vs genuinely new normative prose vs residual verbosity; (c) a SEMANTIC dedup pass the lexical near-dup scan cannot do: same-behavior rules across families phrased differently, procedures restated as prose around a rule that already owns them, elaboration bullets repeating the rule line; (d) a condensation-candidates list ranked by expected word savings. Every candidate worth >~50 words becomes a filed `pre-v0.8` condensation issue (zero semantic change) unless explicitly waived here with rationale. The lens verdict states whether epic AC5 ("total corpus word count reduced with zero information loss") is genuinely met against the pre-epic baseline, not merely batch-arithmetic-met.
8. **Release readiness**: `npm run verify` + `test:docs` + `test:assets` green on main; npm publish chain intact (#1187 fix — release.yml dispatches npm-publish).

## Authority

- Every audit finding that blocks release becomes its own `pre-v0.8` issue in the v0.8 milestone, filed from this issue and linked here.
- This issue closes only when: all filed findings are resolved and merged, all seven scope items pass, and the final audit summary is posted as a comment here.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] All eight audit scope items executed by reviewers independent of the batch PRs, results posted here.
- [ ] Zero open audit-filed issues.
- [ ] Final clean audit summary comment posted; only then may v0.8 be tagged.

text:
name: Create GitHub Release

# Tagging is the only manual release step. Pushing a "v*" tag creates the
# GitHub Release, then dispatches npm-publish.yml explicitly: releases
# created with GITHUB_TOKEN never fire `on: release`, so event chaining
# alone silently skips npm publishing (#1187). workflow_dispatch is the
# documented GITHUB_TOKEN exception.
on:
  push:
    tags:
      - 'v*'

jobs:
  release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
      actions: write
    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v5
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v5
        with:
          node-version: 24

      - name: Derive version from tag
        id: version
        run: |
          TAG="${GITHUB_REF_NAME}"
          echo "tag=${TAG}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "version=${TAG#v}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Verify release commit is on main
        run: |
          git fetch origin main
          if ! git merge-base --is-ancestor HEAD origin/main; then
            echo "::error::Release tag commit $(git rev-parse HEAD) is not an ancestor of origin/main. Releasing is only allowed from the main branch."
            exit 1
          fi

      # Root cause of #1033: fail the release if root `dev-loops` ships an
      # `@dev-loops/core` dependency whose major.minor differs from the version
      # being released (e.g. dev-loops@0.6.2 carrying @dev-loops/core@^0.2.6).
      # node-builtins-only, so it runs without `npm ci`.
      - name: Assert @dev-loops/core dependency is in lockstep with the release
        run: |
          node scripts/release/assert-core-dependency-version.mjs \
            --release-version "${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}"

      - name: Skip if release already exists (idempotent)
        id: exists
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          if gh release view "${{ steps.version.outputs.tag }}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            echo "::notice::Release ${{ steps.version.outputs.tag }} already exists; nothing to do."
            echo "exists=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          else
            echo "exists=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi

      - name: Extract release notes from CHANGELOG.md (fail closed)
        if: steps.exists.outputs.exists == 'false'
        run: |
          node scripts/release/extract-changelog-section.mjs \
            --version "${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}" \
            > release-notes.md

      - name: Create GitHub Release
        if: steps.exists.outputs.exists == 'false'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          gh release create "${{ steps.version.outputs.tag }}" \
            --title "${{ steps.version.outputs.tag }}" \
            --notes-file release-notes.md \
            --latest \
            --verify-tag

      # Not gated on `exists`: re-running after a failed dispatch/publish must
      # retry. npm-publish.yml itself skips versions already on the registry.
      - name: Dispatch npm publish for the release tag
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          gh workflow run npm-publish.yml --ref "${{ steps.version.outputs.tag }}"

content.text:
name: Create GitHub Release

# Tagging is the only manual release step. Pushing a "v*" tag creates the
# GitHub Release, then dispatches npm-publish.yml explicitly: releases
# created with GITHUB_TOKEN never fire `on: release`, so event chaining
# alone silently skips npm publishing (#1187). workflow_dispatch is the
# documented GITHUB_TOKEN exception.
on:
  push:
    tags:
      - 'v*'

jobs:
  release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
      actions: write
    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v5
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v5
        with:
          node-version: 24

      - name: Derive version from tag
        id: version
        run: |
          TAG="${GITHUB_REF_NAME}"
          echo "tag=${TAG}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "version=${TAG#v}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Verify release commit is on main
        run: |
          git fetch origin main
          if ! git merge-base --is-ancestor HEAD origin/main; then
            echo "::error::Release tag commit $(git rev-parse HEAD) is not an ancestor of origin/main. Releasing is only allowed from the main branch."
            exit 1
          fi

      # Root cause of #1033: fail the release if root `dev-loops` ships an
      # `@dev-loops/core` dependency whose major.minor differs from the version
      # being released (e.g. dev-loops@0.6.2 carrying @dev-loops/core@^0.2.6).
      # node-builtins-only, so it runs without `npm ci`.
      - name: Assert @dev-loops/core dependency is in lockstep with the release
        run: |
          node scripts/release/assert-core-dependency-version.mjs \
            --release-version "${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}"

      - name: Skip if release already exists (idempotent)
        id: exists
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          if gh release view "${{ steps.version.outputs.tag }}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            echo "::notice::Release ${{ steps.version.outputs.tag }} already exists; nothing to do."
            echo "exists=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          else
            echo "exists=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi

      - name: Extract release notes from CHANGELOG.md (fail closed)
        if: steps.exists.outputs.exists == 'false'
        run: |
          node scripts/release/extract-changelog-section.mjs \
            --version "${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}" \
            > release-notes.md

      - name: Create GitHub Release
        if: steps.exists.outputs.exists == 'false'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          gh release create "${{ steps.version.outputs.tag }}" \
            --title "${{ steps.version.outputs.tag }}" \
            --notes-file release-notes.md \
            --latest \
            --verify-tag

      # Not gated on `exists`: re-running after a failed dispatch/publish must
      # retry. npm-publish.yml itself skips versions already on the registry.
      - name: Dispatch npm publish for the release tag
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          gh workflow run npm-publish.yml --ref "${{ steps.version.outputs.tag }}"

name: Publish to npm

# release.yml dispatches this with --ref <tag> (GITHUB_TOKEN-created releases
# never fire `on: release`, see #1187); the release trigger remains for
# releases published manually in the UI.
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  release:
    types:
      - published

jobs:
  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v5
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Verify release commit is on main
        run: |
          git fetch origin main
          if ! git merge-base --is-ancestor HEAD origin/main; then
            echo "::error::Release tag commit $(git rev-parse HEAD) is not an ancestor of origin/main. Publishing is only allowed from the main branch."
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v5
        with:
          node-version: 24
          registry-url: 'https://registry.npmjs.org'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run verification
        run: npm run verify

      - name: Dry-run pack core package
        run: npm pack --dry-run -w packages/core

      - name: Dry-run pack root package
        run: npm pack --dry-run

      # Per-package idempotency: a re-run after a partial failure must not
      # fail on the package that already made it to the registry.
      - name: Publish core package to npm
        run: |
          # jq, not `npm pkg get`: inside a workspace npm prints a name->version
          # map, not the bare version.
          VERSION=$(jq -r .version packages/core/package.json)
          if npm view "@dev-loops/core@${VERSION}" version >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            echo "::notice::@dev-loops/core@${VERSION} already published; skipping."
          else
            npm publish -w packages/core --provenance --access public
          fi

      - name: Publish root package to npm
        run: |
          VERSION=$(npm pkg get version | tr -d '"')
          if npm view "dev-loops@${VERSION}" version >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            echo "::notice::dev-loops@${VERSION} already published; skipping."
          else
            npm publish --provenance --access public
          fi

1	name: Create GitHub Release
     2	
     3	# Tagging is the only manual release step. Pushing a "v*" tag creates the
     4	# GitHub Release, then dispatches npm-publish.yml explicitly: releases
     5	# created with GITHUB_TOKEN never fire `on: release`, so event chaining
     6	# alone silently skips npm publishing (#1187). workflow_dispatch is the
     7	# documented GITHUB_TOKEN exception.
     8	on:
     9	  push:
    10	    tags:
    11	      - 'v*'
    12	
    13	jobs:
    14	  release:
    15	    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    16	    permissions:
    17	      contents: write
    18	      actions: write
    19	    steps:
    20	      - name: Check out repository
    21	        uses: actions/checkout@v5
    22	        with:
    23	          fetch-depth: 0
    24	
    25	      - name: Set up Node
    26	        uses: actions/setup-node@v5
    27	        with:
    28	          node-version: 24
    29	
    30	      - name: Derive version from tag
    31	        id: version
    32	        run: |
    33	          TAG="${GITHUB_REF_NAME}"
    34	          echo "tag=${TAG}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
    35	          echo "version=${TAG#v}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
    36	
    37	      - name: Verify release commit is on main
    38	        run: |
    39	          git fetch origin main
    40	          if ! git merge-base --is-ancestor HEAD origin/main; then
    41	            echo "::error::Release tag commit $(git rev-parse HEAD) is not an ancestor of origin/main. Releasing is only allowed from the main branch."
    42	            exit 1
    43	          fi
    44	
    45	      # Root cause of #1033: fail the release if root `dev-loops` ships an
    46	      # `@dev-loops/core` dependency whose major.minor differs from the version
    47	      # being released (e.g. dev-loops@0.6.2 carrying @dev-loops/core@^0.2.6).
    48	      # node-builtins-only, so it runs without `npm ci`.
    49	      - name: Assert @dev-loops/core dependency is in lockstep with the release
    50	        run: |
    51	          node scripts/release/assert-core-dependency-version.mjs \
    52	            --release-version "${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}"
    53	
    54	      - name: Skip if release already exists (idempotent)
    55	        id: exists
    56	        env:
    57	          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
    58	        run: |
    59	          if gh release view "${{ steps.version.outputs.tag }}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    60	            echo "::notice::Release ${{ steps.version.outputs.tag }} already exists; nothing to do."
    61	            echo "exists=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
    62	          else
    63	            echo "exists=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
    64	          fi
    65	
    66	      - name: Extract release notes from CHANGELOG.md (fail closed)
    67	        if: steps.exists.outputs.exists == 'false'
    68	        run: |
    69	          node scripts/release/extract-changelog-section.mjs \
    70	            --version "${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}" \
    71	            > release-notes.md
    72	
    73	      - name: Create GitHub Release
    74	        if: steps.exists.outputs.exists == 'false'
    75	        env:
    76	          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
    77	        run: |
    78	          gh release create "${{ steps.version.outputs.tag }}" \
    79	            --title "${{ steps.version.outputs.tag }}" \
    80	            --notes-file release-notes.md \
    81	            --latest \
    82	            --verify-tag
    83	
    84	      # Not gated on `exists`: re-running after a failed dispatch/publish must
    85	      # retry. npm-publish.yml itself skips versions already on the registry.
    86	      - name: Dispatch npm publish for the release tag
    87	        env:
    88	          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
    89	        run: |
    90	          gh workflow run npm-publish.yml --ref "${{ steps.version.outputs.tag }}"

     2	
     3	# release.yml dispatches this with --ref <tag> (GITHUB_TOKEN-created releases
     4	# never fire `on: release`, see #1187); the release trigger remains for
     5	# releases published manually in the UI.
     6	on:
     7	  workflow_dispatch:
     8	  release:
     9	    types:
    10	      - published
    11	
    12	jobs:
    13	  publish:
    14	    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    15	    permissions:
    16	      contents: read
    17	      id-token: write
    18	    steps:
    19	      - name: Check out repository
    20	        uses: actions/checkout@v5
    21	        with:
    22	          fetch-depth: 0
    23	
    24	      - name: Verify release commit is on main
    25	        run: |
    26	          git fetch origin main
    27	          if ! git merge-base --is-ancestor HEAD origin/main; then
    28	            echo "::error::Release tag commit $(git rev-parse HEAD) is not an ancestor of origin/main. Publishing is only allowed from the main branch."
    29	            exit 1
    30	          fi
    31	
    32	      - name: Set up Node.js
    33	        uses: actions/setup-node@v5
    34	        with:
    35	          node-version: 24
    36	          registry-url: 'https://registry.npmjs.org'
    37	
    38	      - name: Install dependencies
    39	        run: npm ci
    40	
    41	      - name: Run verification
    42	        run: npm run verify
    43	
    44	      - name: Dry-run pack core package
    45	        run: npm pack --dry-run -w packages/core
    46	
    47	      - name: Dry-run pack root package
    48	        run: npm pack --dry-run
    49	
    50	      # Per-package idempotency: a re-run after a partial failure must not
    51	      # fail on the package that already made it to the registry.
    52	      - name: Publish core package to npm
    53	        run: |
    54	          # jq, not `npm pkg get`: inside a workspace npm prints a name->version
    55	          # map, not the bare version.
    56	          VERSION=$(jq -r .version packages/core/package.json)
    57	          if npm view "@dev-loops/core@${VERSION}" version >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    58	            echo "::notice::@dev-loops/core@${VERSION} already published; skipping."
    59	          else
    60	            npm publish -w packages/core --provenance --access public
    61	          fi
    62	
    63	      - name: Publish root package to npm
    64	        run: |
    65	          VERSION=$(npm pkg get version | tr -d '"')
    66	          if npm view "dev-loops@${VERSION}" version >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    67	            echo "::notice::dev-loops@${VERSION} already published; skipping."
    68	          else
    69	            npm publish --provenance --access public
    70	          fi

   242	export function registerMachine(machine) {
